rule: Scale in batches. Do not unlock broad multi-account posting until seed accounts have fresh drafts and measured feedback.

blockers.title: Posted rows have no X Analytics yet
blockers.detail: 1 posted rows are pending metrics, so the system cannot learn what to repeat.
blockers.nextAction: Open Feedback, fill the pending template, paste X Analytics, then rerun npm run feedback-ops.

blockers.title: Feedback gate is limiting new posts
blockers.detail: The current safe-new-post limit is 0, far below the daily target.
blockers.nextAction: Clear pending metrics first; do not increase account volume while the gate is closed.

blockers.title: Not enough fresh publish candidates
blockers.detail: 0 fresh candidates are available for posting today.
blockers.nextAction: Refresh Live Feed and import external candidates from the source supply workbench.

blockers.title: Draft gap is too large for the target
blockers.nextAction: Fill source-pack rows, rerun daily, then rerun draft-plan and content-calendar.

blockers.title: Account-level content matrix is not ready
blockers.detail: 0/20 accounts are ready; candidate bench is 12/600, strong 0, fresh 0.
blockers.nextAction: Run npm run account-matrix, then fill account-level search tasks until the 196 draft gap shrinks.

blockers.title: Source supply is below target
blockers.detail: 105 more source candidates are needed for the current account mix.
blockers.nextAction: Fill the 100 source-pack rows that still need real candidates.

blockers.title: Real multi-account X auth is not connected
blockers.detail: Account profiles exist, but OAuth binding is intentionally not the current bottleneck.
blockers.nextAction: Keep auth deferred until feedback and source quality gates are stable.

stages.label: Phase 1 seed batch
stages.exitCriteria: Post up to 3 manually reviewed tweets, then import X Analytics feedback.

stages.label: Phase 2 next batch
stages.exitCriteria: Each account needs 10 drafts, 10 fresh candidates, and at least one feedback row.

stages.label: Phase 3 hold / research only
stages.exitCriteria: Do not post until the account has a 3x candidate bench and unique drafts.
